qualification.education_qualification: PhD or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Biomedical/Electronics/Mechanical, B-Tech/ M-Tech in Mechanical/Electronics/Biomedical
qualification.details: Project Scientist I Non-Medical (Post 1): PhD in Biomedical/Electronics/Mechanical or First-Class M-Tech in Biomedical/Electronics/Mechanical with two years of experience. Experience in Neurosurgical Instrumentation, Robotics, Finite Element Analysis, Computer Aided Design, Precision Machining, 3D Printing, 3D Scanning, Reverse Engineering. Patents and Research Publications in peer-reviewed journals. Project Scientist I Non-Medical (Post 2): PhD in AI/Computer Science/Electronics/Instrumentation/Biomedical or M.Tech with two years of experience. Experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Biomedical Signal Processing, Data Analysis, Computer Vision, Neural Networks, integration of AI/ML with medical-device applications. Building AI models and Deploying, Deep Learning, Neural networks, Data analysis, Biomedical Signal Processing, Image Processing, CT-MRI. Project Scientist I Non-Medical (Post 3): PhD in AI/Computer Science/Electronics/Instrumentation/Biomedical or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Neuroscience, Biomedical Sciences or related life sciences with two years of experience. Experience in Neurosurgical Simulation, Artificial Intelligence, Neurophysiology, Neural Interface & Electrodes, Image Segmentation and 3D Printing. Strong understanding of neuroscience, neuroanatomy and hands-on experience on IONM and Neuro-navigation Systems. Project Technical Support III: B-Tech in Mechanical/Electronics/Biomedical with 3 years of experience or M-Tech in Mechanical/Electronics/Biomedical. Experience in Medical Electronics, Sensor Integration, Microcontrollers, Data Acquisition Systems, Analog and Digital Electronics, Signal Conditioning, Electronic Circuit Design, Hardware-Software Integration, development/testing of medical devices and electronic prototypes.

salary_details.details: Project Scientist I Non-Medical: Rs. 56,000/- + 30% HRA Per Month Project Technical Support III: Rs. 28,000/- + 30% HRA Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Project Scientist I Non-Medical (Post 3): PhD in AI/Computer Science/Electronics/Instrumentation/Biomedical or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Neuroscience, Biomedical Sciences or related life sciences with two years of experience. Experience in Neurosurgical Simulation, Artificial Intelligence, Neurophysiology, Neural Interface & Electrodes, Image Segmentation and 3D Printing. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist-I Non-Medical?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Project Scientist-I Non-Medical post in the AIIMS Delhi recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For the Project Technical Support-III position, candidates need a B-Tech in Mechanical/Electronics/Biomedical with 3 years of experience or an M-Tech in Mechanical/Electronics/Biomedical.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this AIIMS Delhi recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts (Project Scientist-I Non-Medical and Project Technical Support-III) is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Scientist-I Non-Medical?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist-I Non-Medical post offers a salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply via Email for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Scientist-I Non-Medical and Project Technical Support-III are on a contractual basis.
